incomplete_fix_quote: This patch release includes a moderate severity security fix for directory traversal ... CVE-2021-43813 ... This is a follow-up patch release to the recent CVE-2021-43798 release. Given the attention CVE-2021-43798 has brought, there's a risk that additional researchers will find CVE-2021-43813.
root_cause: The CVE-2021-43798 fix (8.3.1) hardened only getPluginAssets ('/public/plugins/:pluginId/*') by resolving the requested file relative to the plugin dir's absolute path and clamping it (see patch.diff). It left the sibling markdown endpoint GetPluginMarkdown ('/api/plugins/:pluginId/markdown/:name') untouched: that handler builds filepath.Join(plugin.PluginDir, ToUpper(name)+'.md') (fallback ToLower(name)+'.md') with no containment check on name, so the same class of '../' traversal still escapes the plugin dir. Reported by GHSL (@pwntester / Alvaro Munoz). Fixed in 8.3.2 by clamping the markdown path too.
auth_difference: Original 43798 is unauthenticated; residual 43813 requires any authenticated user (viewer suffices). In this env admin:admin basic auth is used.
extension_constraint: 43813 disclosure is limited to files whose basename is fully upper- OR fully lower-case with a '.md' extension appended by the handler; the canary is /tmp/pcb_canary.md accordingly.

patch_refs.v0_to_v1_43798_fix: grafana v8.3.0 -> v8.3.1, pkg/api/plugins.go getPluginAssets (see patch.diff)
patch_refs.v1_to_v2_43813_fix: grafana v8.3.1 -> v8.3.2, plugin markdown path clamped
